messages:
Aria: T-30 until our minor release (routing-config patch). Quick sync — who is running the deploy and who has rollback?
Daniel: I'm on deploy. I'll kick the canary at T-20. Sam, can you own smoke?
Sam: Yep, I'll run smoke. Plan: 5m canary -> ramp. Priya for rollback? @Priya
Priya: I'll own rollback. If error rate > 2% or latency spike > 300ms, I will flip back to v1.2.2 and open incident if needed.
Deploy Bot: deploy-bot scheduled deploy window set for 2026-04-05 18:30 UTC by Daniel. Canary window 5m, health checks enabled.
Aria: Short checklist: 1) infra ✅ 2) no DB migrations 3) perf sanity checked 4) QA smoke ready. Please ack each item.
Luca: 1) infra ok, 2) confirmed no migrations, ack :white_check_mark:
QA: Smoke harness is primed. I'll run the basic suite and post results when done.
Sam: Smoke commands I'm using:
```
kubectl --context=prod exec -it smoke-runner -- /bin/sh -c "./run_smoke.sh"
curl -fsS https://proxy.redwood.example/health || echo FAIL
```
QA: Smoke run complete — all green. Latency P95 120ms, errors 0.1%, no 5xx. Screenshot uploaded to release doc.
Daniel: Kicking canary now. Deploying tag `v1.2.3-canary` to 1 node. Observability link: https://dash/release/4387654321
Aria: Rollback steps (copyable):
- `kubectl set image deploy/api api=redwood/api:v1.2.2`
- disable new routing flag: `curl -XPOST https://flags.internal/api/flags/routing -d '{"enabled":false}'`
Priya: I have console access and creds. Can perform rollback within ~2m of command. Standing by. :rocket:
Sam: Watching logs and token throughput. Will alert if error rate changes or tail latency rises.
Deploy Bot: deploy-bot Canary started (1 node). Auto-scale scheduled after 5m if no failures.
Daniel: Canary stable at +4m. No errors, metrics are steady. Proceeding to ramp to 10%.
Aria: Final sign-off from release coordinator before full ramp?
Release Coordinator: Release looks good to me. :thumbsup: Proceed with ramp.
Priya: Rollback standby but not required at this time.
Aria: Thanks team — will add note to ops: tiny routing tweak, no DB impact. Closing thread once cutover completes.
